semiconductor_relevance: High — Alltek specializes in semiconductor equipment and system engineering services, providing solutions for advanced packaging and testing.
summary: Alltek Company, founded in 1990, is a technology firm that delivers high-performance semiconductor equipment and system engineering services. They support customers globally with equipment selection, system integration, and turnkey project implementation, focusing on advanced packaging and testing applications.
capabilities: Microwave & RF hybrid integrated circuit solutions

regional_presence.China: Alltek has established a comprehensive sales and technical support network across major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, with a spare parts center and demo facility in Shanghai.
